create_s3_import_storage: create an S3 import storage instance with bucket, prefix, and AWS credentials for reading data files
create_s3_export_storage: create an S3 export storage instance with bucket and prefix for writing annotation data
test_s3_connection: test the S3 storage connection by validating bucket access with prefix and region configuration
run_s3_iter_objects: iterate over S3 storage objects filtered by prefix, delimiter, and regex pattern
build_s3_annotation_export: build an S3 export pipeline that saves annotation data to S3 on post-save and deletes on pre-delete
